reader.notes: Random READ, REWRITE and DELETE all slice the key from the record area through one KeyOf path. The single edition arm (02 on random alternate duplicates) takes the 1985 branch at --std 85, measured.

refuter.evidence: Probe rc_multi.cob (run rc_multi-001): RANDOM access, two 01 records, RECORD VARYING 6 TO 12 DEPENDING ON. The prime key value was moved through REC-B's B-KEY (the key is declared in REC-A), and READ selected K02 with RL=06. REWRITE and DELETE through the other record's field hit the right records (DELETE K01 00, then READ K01 23). An absent alternate 'BBB' gave 23. OK §1985:IX.2.4.4 GR3 'the value of a record key data item for indexed files indicates the record to be accessed'. Together with the reader's p4/p7 (figurative values, group keys, alternate random reads), no form of 1985 is left that differs.
